questionResults.question: Who has seen the most individual birds
questionResults.sql:
SELECT u.username, COUNT(DISTINCT bs.bird_id) AS total_birds
FROM `Bird Sighting` bs
JOIN `users` u ON bs.person_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY u.username
ORDER BY total_birds DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Sure! The person who has seen the most individual birds is "sydney_sky_spotter" with 10 birds.

questionResults.question: Who has been a user the longest
questionResults.sql:
SELECT username 
FROM users 
ORDER BY date_Joined ASC 
LIMIT 1;

questionResults.question: What was the common name of the last bird seen by Sydney_sky_spotter
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `Species`.`common name`
FROM `Bird Sighting`
JOIN `Bird` ON `Bird Sighting`.`bird_id` = `Bird`.`id`
JOIN `Species` ON `Bird`.`Species_id` = `Species`.`Species_id`
JOIN `users` ON `Bird Sighting`.`person_id` = `users`.`user_id`
WHERE `users`.`username` = 'Sydney_sky_spotter'
ORDER BY `Bird Sighting`.`Sighting date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
